harddrop.pages: every member of Category:Triple Double openers, read as wikitext (action=query prop=revisions rvprop=content|ids through api.php)
harddrop.revisions: NOT PINNED: the fetch script saved no revision ids and the wikitext is not committed, so these shapes can only be re-read from a fresh fetch (--wikitext-dir), never pinned to what was transcribed
harddrop.name_form: <page title> <board number>, numbering every {{pfstart}} board of the page from 0
harddrop.rule: a board is a shape when it draws exactly four P cells as a stood T that completes three rows, no muted L? cell, and passes the survey filter (whole tetrominoes, 36 to 52 cells, at most 8 rows, no full row without the T)

routes.rule: every node with rows whose filled cells (letters other than U) pass the survey filter, with the stood-T placement that completes three rows found by search; opener-fields.json and wiki-openers.json were surveyed with the same filter and gave no shape
routes.pinned: committed files, re-read by the checker on every run

johnbeak.revisions: NOT PINNED: a plain web page, not committed; its fumens were decoded once with the tetris-fumen library and the decoded rows are recorded here
johnbeak.reading: in the recorded rows T is the T, every other letter and G is a filled cell

user.note: one board a user drew; no recoverable source
